title: [test] App.tsx badge refresh wiring fires on mount, task change and notification response
description:

Add __tests__/badgeWiring.test.ts — a plain jest + fs source-assertion suite (read App.tsx with fs.readFileSync). No react renderer: the repo has NO @testing-library/react-native and NO declared react-test-renderer devDependency, and none may be added. Same convention as __tests__/appAssets.test.ts.

WHAT TO TEST (whitespace-tolerant regexes over the App.tsx source; every failure message must name the missing wiring):
1. IMPORTS: App.tsx imports computeBadgeCount from './utils/badge' and setBadgeCount (and/or clearBadge) from './notificationService'.
2. CALLBACK: a refreshBadge callback exists (useCallback) whose body calls computeBadgeCount( ... ) and passes the result to setBadgeCount( ... ) — assert the count is computed, not a literal.

7. ZERO CASE: the source path that reaches setBadgeCount can pass 0 (no special-case early return that skips the call when the count is 0), so the badge is cleared rather than left stale.

HOW TO ASSERT: jest expect() on each regex result with a check-naming message; keep all patterns in one table so adding a check is one line.
